title: USF-175 file scanner provider disposition matrix

humanDecision.decisionSummary: File scanner provider parity is split by semantic requirement. Deterministic in-memory scan markers are accepted only where service catalogue authority permits them and are not equivalent to ClamAV composed provider semantics.

scannerProviderDisposition.riskStatement: ClamAV service semantics could be claimed from deterministic in-memory scan markers, files capability proof, or service catalogue presence without composed scanner provider evidence.
scannerProviderDisposition.treatment: Defer ClamAV SDK/client or protocol-exception selection, adapter implementation, scan invocation, clean/infected outcome proof, fail-closed quarantine routing, release boundary, deletion, retention, tenant isolation, readiness retry, failure-mode, audit, teardown, supplier, incident, privacy, and provider proof to USF-200.
scannerProviderDisposition.deferredEvidence: USF-175 records the bounded disposition gate, non-equivalence boundary, runtime manifest deferral, enterprise evidence rows, validator coverage, and planted defects only.

deterministicScanSubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: Deterministic in-memory scan markers and files capability proof are not equivalent to ClamAV composed provider scan invocation, signature database posture, clean/infected wire response semantics, provider unavailable handling, timeout, readiness retry, release workflow, retention, deletion, audit operation evidence, supplier posture, or teardown behaviour.
scopeCovered: tenant-safe hermetic file scan status and quarantine proof where semantically permitted
files capability proof posture from USF-147/USF-146 lineage
value-free repository evidence and validation linkage
limits: does not prove ClamAV adapter binding
does not prove ClamAV clean or infected scan response compatibility
does not prove ClamAV signature database freshness or update posture
does not prove provider unavailable, timeout, readiness retry, or failure-mode behaviour
does not prove composed scanner quarantine release, deletion, retention, or teardown
does not prove live scanner, DLP, vulnerability-clearance, test, staging, production, SOC, ISO, full dev, or full React parity readiness

providerBoundary.providerRegistryEvidence: packages/core/src/index.ts records file-scan-clamav-deferred as deferred evidence-only support linked to the ClamAV service catalogue row.

semanticProofBoundaries.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Deterministic marker proof is not ClamAV composed provider scan invocation or clean/infected response proof.
Hermetic file lifecycle proof does not prove ClamAV provider failure, timeout, quarantine routing, privileged release boundary, deletion, retention, or cleanup behaviour.

USF-175 does not select a scanner SDK/client, approve a lower-level protocol exception, prove supplier posture, incident posture, vulnerability posture, scan payload privacy, or scanner evidence retention.
